title: Confined Muse sessions keep writable session state
description: Under real bubblewrap, through the launcher's own confinement, a stand-in Muse worker and reviewer create, lock and persist their session under the selected account's XDG data directory — the default under HOME, an explicit XDG_DATA_HOME/XDG_CONFIG_HOME, and an account home set on XDG_DATA_HOME — while unrelated host directories stay unwritable and another account's home stays unreadable. Before GY-3303 the session failed with 'failed to create session lock directory … Read-only file system'.

steps.name: confined Muse persists its session state
